articles.title: National Digital Urban Governance Mission: Accelerating Smart Local Bodies
articles.summary: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs expands open-source digital architecture to strengthen Tier-2 and Tier-3 Urban Local Bodies.
prelims: National Urban Digital Mission (NUDM) creates citizen-centric digital public infrastructure for urban governance.
Implements open-source standards for municipal service delivery across local government entities.
Supports Article 243W (74th Constitutional Amendment Act) by empowering municipal administrative capabilities.
articles.mains: Use to illustrate the role of Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) in administrative decentralization and strengthening democratic local governance.

articles.title: Deep Ocean Mission: Samudrayaan Completes Deep-Sea Trials in Central Indian Ocean
articles.summary: India advances its deep-sea exploration capabilities targeting polymetallic nodules and marine biodiversity mapping.
prelims: MATSYA 6000 is an indigenously developed crewed submersible designed to operate at 6,000-meter ocean depths.
Nodal agency is the National Institute of Ocean Technology (NIOT) under the Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES).
International Seabed Authority (ISA) has allocated exploration sites to India in the Central Indian Ocean Basin.
articles.mains: Crucial for analyzing India's resource security, Blue Economy ambitions, and strategic posture in the Indian Ocean Region.

articles.title: National Quantum Mission: Deployment of Satellite-Based QKD Network
articles.summary: ISRO and DRDO successfully test secure Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) communications link using low-Earth orbit satellites.
prelims: Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) utilizes principles of quantum mechanics (superposition and entanglement) for unhackable encryption.
National Quantum Mission (NQM) is implemented by the Department of Science and Technology (DST).
Focuses on four thematic hubs: Quantum Computing, Communication, Sensing & Metrology, and Materials.
articles.mains: Highlight in answers related to national cybersecurity preparedness, defense communication autonomy, and critical technology R&D.

articles.title: India-Africa Critical Minerals Partnership Framework Approved
articles.summary: India strengthens diplomatic ties with African nations to secure strategic supply chains for rare earth elements and energy-transition metals.
prelims: Critical minerals include lithium, cobalt, nickel, and graphite, vital for electric mobility and renewable energy storage.
Khanij Bidesh India Limited (KABIL) is a joint venture of NALCO, HCL, and MECL tasked with acquiring foreign strategic mineral assets.
Aligns with South-South Cooperation frameworks and the expansion of the African Union within the G20.
articles.mains: Useful for questions on India's foreign policy towards Africa, critical mineral diplomacy, and economic supply chain resilience.

articles.title: Integrated Early Warning System Deployed for Himalayan Glacial Lakes
articles.summary: NDMA installs automated weather and water-level monitoring stations at high-risk glacial lakes in the Indian Himalayan Region.
prelims: Glacial Lake Outburst Floods (GLOF) occur when a moraine-dammed or ice-dammed lake breaches, releasing large volumes of water.
National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA) guidelines emphasize sensor-based early monitoring and Community-Based Early Warning Systems (CBEWS).
The Indian Himalayan Region contains over 28,000 glacial bodies vulnerable to climate-induced retreat.
articles.mains: Provides concrete evidence for disaster risk reduction (DRR), climate adaptation strategies, and eco-sensitive infrastructure development in mountain ecosystems.
